summary: The change interpolates the payee's unsealed account number into the log message on the statement-delivery error path. AppLog masks only keyword fields, not message text, so the full account number would be logged, violating LOG-1. No exception covers payments for LOG-1. CI is green only because the sample LOG-1 control test exercises the success path. The process records (ticket, independent approval on the head commit, CI on the head commit) are in order, but the product violation means the change must be rejected.
